excluded.reason: AppWorks only: lets the bridge's modules, loaded from a checkout, resolve @appport/* from AppWorks' pinned copies. Inside Memos the bridge resolves its own dependencies.
AppWorks only: the resolution hook register.mjs installs.

run: MEMOS_REPO=<the Memos repository root> APPPORT_BRIDGE_UPSTREAM=<Memos origin> node appport-bridge/appworks/memos-reactions/runtime/host.mjs

q-adopt-contract.reason: This adoption answers it: org.appworks.contracts.memos memos.reactions.list@1 is adopted into the Memos bridge's integration as the file the promotion adds, under that contract id. It is not registered anywhere else.

q-anonymous.reason: Through AppPort a credential is always required, which is narrower than Memos' PublicMethods and never wider; authorization.unauthenticated-denied and the other authorization behaviors passed against the real Memos for exactly this contract. Offering anonymous reads would be a new contract version.

q-merge-bridge.reason: rkendel1/memos merged appport/bridge-manifest-attributes into its main in #2 (4fd4626). Upstream usememos/memos is not established.

limitations.description: The promotion adds the capability as a host beside the bridge (appport-bridge/appworks/memos-reactions/runtime/host.mjs), composing the unmodified bridge; the bridge's own entry point (bridge.mjs) is unchanged and does not serve memos.reactions.list.
The promoted host is the verified file, byte for byte, so it still locates the bridge through MEMOS_REPO (the repository root) rather than a relative path.
The patch does not change appport-bridge/package.json or its lockfile. The promotion's requirements record what the lockfile pins against what the host was verified with.
